title: Rank and cap routed principles and refuse unknown principle names at cap
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo clippy --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee principle

truths: parse_principles reads an optional signals line per row as a list of tokens
principle_lines takes route hints (lane, flags, touched files) and ranks the class's rows by signal matches, then fewer classes, then file order
at most principles_cap rows print, default 7, read from the repo config key principles_cap, and the remaining slugs print as one extra line
bee orient, the session preamble and the worker principles arm all call the same ranked function; the worker arm passes the cell's files and its feature's lane
a class with no more rows than the cap prints the same rows as before, ranked
a cap or finish refuses a principles_used slug that names no Principle homes row, and an entry whose changed part is empty
a known slug outside the routed list is accepted and recorded with off_route true in the trace
key_links: principle_lines is the one reader of the index
prohibitions: Do not add a second reader of the index
Do not refuse a known off-route slug
must_haves.why: A 29-row principle list is skimmed and the cap accepts any principle name.
out_of_scope: changing which classes a row routes to

action: Implement CONTEXT.md D4 and D5 of docs/history/pstack-guide-gaps/CONTEXT.md in the bee CLI (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee). Facts from the code map: principle_lines(root, class) at src/principles.rs:116 is the one reader; parse_principles at :48-98 reads spoken and classes and ignores other continuation lines; render_lines at :128 filters by class in file order with no cap; orient calls it at src/verbs/status_full/orient.rs:638-649 and :746; the session preamble calls it (src/hooks/session_preamble/budget.rs); the worker arm is cell_principles at src/verbs/drivers/prepare.rs:1208-1227 (class from plan_group::route_class); the cap reader is read_principles_used_answer at src/verbs/cells/handlers_close.rs:1226-1255 with the trace write at :735-750; finish_support.rs:295-299 type-checks principles_used; herding/mailbox.rs:857-872 parses it from a herded result. (1) Add a signals field to the parsed row (optional comma list, trimmed). (2) Introduce a small hints value (lane: Option, flags: list, files: list) and change principle_lines to take it; callers with no route pass empty hints. A token matches when it equals the lane or a flag (case-insensitive) or, as a glob, matches any touched file path. Rank: signal match count descending, then number of classes ascending, then file order. (3) Cap: read principles_cap from the repo config (follow how principles_holdout_percent is read and registered; it is read straight from config with no registry), default 7, a value below 1 falls back to 7. Print the top rows as today, then one line naming the remaining slugs when any remain, worded so the reader knows they are lower-ranked rows of the same class and can still be applied by name. (4) Orient and preamble pass lane and flags from the route; the worker arm passes the cell's files and the feature's lane. (5) D5: in read_principles_used_answer and in the finish path, refuse with a typed message naming the bad entry and the fix when a slug matches no index row (use the same parse) or when the changed text is empty; when the slug is a known row but not in the routed list for this cell, record off_route: true beside slug and changed in the trace. (6) Fix existing tests that break only because the signature changed; do NOT write new tests: the tester cell pgg-4 writes them. (7) Knowledge sync: in the Principle homes grammar paragraph of docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md, state the ranking order, the cap key and default, and the overflow line, citing docs/history/pstack-guide-gaps/CONTEXT.md D4 and D5 (D-numbers, never raw ids); if docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/dispatch.md describes the principles arm or the principles_used cap answer, update that sentence. Allowed commands: cargo build, cargo clippy and cargo test with a filter, git. Never run the full suite, any bee dispatch verb or its help. No code comments in any language. Proof: the verify command output.
